## Checklist
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` and `python3 tools/check_names.py` pass
- [ ] I ran `tools/smoke.py` if I changed the server (or say why not)
- [ ] No keys, tokens, real names or addresses in the change (`tools/hooks/pre-commit`)
- [ ] New assets are listed in `docs/ASSETS.md` with their license
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
